item.title: Flush with donations, Hochul opts out of NY matching funds for re-election campaign
item.description: Gov. Hochul has a significant fundraising lead over her Republican challenger Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman. Hochul, a Democrat, said she won’t opt into the program to save taxpayer money. [ more › ]

item.title: How much snow can NYC rooftops really handle?
item.description: A foot of snow on a roof can weigh as much as five pounds per square foot, according to the emergency management agency for Maine, a state that is no stranger to big snowfalls. The weight of the snow and ice are wreaking havoc on NYC rooftops. [ more › ]

item.title: Not like the last one: Warm weather set to begin melting snow in NYC later this week
item.description: The snow that blanketed the city this week is expected to begin melting in a matter of days. Last month's blizzard was followed by a deep freeze that entombed the city in snow and ice for weeks. This time around, nature is expected to bring some relatively quick relief. [ more › ]

item.title: Facing historic blizzard, Mamdani says NYC learned lessons from last snowstorm
item.description: Mayor Mamdani and acting Sanitation Commissioner Javier Lojan said they adjusted operations following yesterday's storm. "We took a hard look at everything that worked," Mamdani said. [ more › ]

item.description: Customer assistants help commuters as they make their way through a crowded Hoboken transit hub. Officials say light rail returns Monday afternoon and commuter rail resumes on holiday schedule with modifications after blizzard. [ more › ]
